messages:
sophia: Quick sync — procurement vs forecast mismatch for the Q3 dedicated ramp. Contract shows 480 reserved GPUs but our capacity plan needs ~560 (canary + prod). Who owns negotiation/rollover and can we get a decision timeline?

raj: I thought procurement had ~80 on a pending PO? @kevin?

kevin: We do have 80 on backorder with the vendor. ETA on the full shipment is 2024-08-12. Contract allows rolling 40 to the next quarter, not the full 80. I can share the clause excerpt if helpful.

micah: From infra side — is there any tolerance to reduce immediate needs? Options: reduce canary proportion (25% vs 30%), enable burst to hosted pool, or use a lower-mem model for the canary. Each has tradeoffs.

anya: SRE note — rack 7 power/cooling is marginal for +4 H100s. Need final PDU and thermal sign-off before we commit. @lia can you confirm PDU headroom?

lia: PDU check: Circuit A currently at ~70% with baseline load. Adding 4 H100s moves that to ~95%. We either need to: (a) redistribute 8 noncritical nodes off circuit A, or (b) provision a new circuit. I've opened OPS ticket OPS-3421 for the work.

kevin: The vendor can expedite the entire 80 to 2024-07-30 at +12% expedite fee, or we can split — expedite 40 and roll 40 to next quarter under contract. Which do we prefer?

sophia: Preference is to hit canary on schedule. Proposal: expedite 40 GPUs (cover canary + initial prod), roll 40 to next quarter. Owners: procurement = @kevin, infra = @micah, sres = @anya. Can we get firm buy-in by tomorrow EOD?

raj: I can update the capacity plan with deltas and cost impact. Will surface numbers in the doc and ping procurement PR.

micah: I'll prepare an infra mitigation: move 8 staging GPUs from rack 7 to rack 12 to free PDU headroom, and repurpose 4 staging nodes to the dedicated canary pool. Opening infra change now. Doc: https://redwood.internal/ops/capacity/commit-recon (please don't share externally).

lia: OPS-3421 created. ETA for redistribution after approval: ~48 hours. Ops needs approval on the infra change to proceed.

kevin: Noted. I'll draft the expedited PO for 40 units and update the vendor terms. Also adding the contract clause that allows 40 rollovers to next quarter so legal is aligned.

sophia: Action summary (for the channel):
- Procurement: expedite 40 GPUs, prep PO (owner: kevin).
- Infra: submit and track infra change for rack 7 redistribution (owner: micah).
- SRE/Ops: execute OPS-3421 once infra change approved (owner: lia).
- Finance: expect ~+12% on expedited portion, raj please add cost delta.
- Engineering: hold canary sizing at new proposed % until we confirm hardware.

micah: Slight ask — need a small reservation API tweak to support partial rollovers (flag to mark N of M GPUs rollover_allowed). I've got a small PR but need prod owner review.

kevin: Ping me the PR. I can review today. Link: https://git.internal/redwood/capacity/pull/789 (adds `rollover_allowed` and delta validation).

micah: Local check snippet for anyone wanting to validate current reservations before/after changes:
```bash
rw capacity reservations list --env prod --owner dedicated-ramp
```

ops-bot: deploybot: PR 789 opened in capacity repo (infra/capacity). Status: OPEN.

anya: Quick note on monitoring — I'll add an alert for allocation drift and PDU current > 90% on rack 7 so we don't accidentally overload during the window.

sophia: Great. Please update OPS-3421 and the capacity doc with links to the PO change and PR. We'll review in tomorrow stand if anything is still outstanding. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
